snippet.title: Metal Eden - New Gameplay Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom
snippet.description:
A brand new gameplay trailer for Metal Eden, an adrenaline fueled sci-fi FPS coming to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and Series S and PC on September 2nd. 
The trailer showcases new environments and weapons, and introduces a new character known as “The Operator”.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #metaleden
